description: Execute any extended tool from Spica Post’s full catalog discovered via tools_search (such as links_save, articles_save, templates_render, inbox_reply, crossposts_save, schedule_batch, team_invite or webhooks_save), with full schema validation, role checks and plan limits. Always confirm with the user before publishing, replying publicly, sending invites or changing live settings.

args.description: Arguments matching the target tool’s parameters from tools_search (pass brandId at top level).

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tool.description: Exact extended tool name from tools_search (e.g. "links_save", "articles_save", "templates_render", "inbox_reply", "schedule_batch", "webhooks_save").

name: tools_run

result.description: Delegated tool result object or list.

title: Run an extended catalog tool
